 Billie Eilish To Headline BST Hyde Park 2027 
 Her first time headlining the festival... 
 Robin Murray 
 Live 
 20 · 11 · 2026 
 Billie Eilish is set to headline BST Hyde Park 2027 .
 The American songwriter will make her first ever BST Hyde Park appearance next summer, bringing her ecstatic live show to the Great Oak Stage.
 Taking place on July 3rd, Billie Eilish will be joined by a series of guest support artists, to be unveiled in the coming weeks.
 It’s another bold move for the star, who became the youngest artist to receive nominations and win in all the major categories at the 62nd GRAMMY® Awards, receiving an award for Best New Artist, Album of the Year, Record of the Year, Song of the Year, and Best Pop Vocal Album.
 On a topical note, Billie remains the youngest artist to write and record an official James Bond theme song, ‘No Time To Die’, which won an Academy Award for Best Original Song in 2022.
 Recent album ‘HIT ME HARD AND SOFT’ was sculpted alongside brother FINNEA, and won overwhelming critical acclaim.
 BST Hyde Park look unmissable next summer, with Billie joining the previously announced BON JOVI (Thursday 24 June), MUSE (Saturday 26 June) and RAYE (Saturday 10 and Sunday 11 July). Tickets go on general sale on Thursday 26 November at 10am GMT. Visit www.bst-hydepark.com
